stage: after a malformed provider header was encountered during acquisition; before any new-seed internal or fresh-external prediction evaluation
reason: WFDB rejected a provider record header with an invalid date field (time data slash does not match day/month/year). The date is not a predictor, but the locked decoder cannot establish eligibility for this record.
decision: Keep the fixed1000-header selection. Mark provider headers with this specific invalid-date parse failure as ineligible: unparseable_provider_date. Do not repair source bytes, replace the sampled record, adjust sample size, or infer its AF label. Other source errors still stop acquisition.
reporting: Report parse-failure exclusion count separately, with all selected header hashes verified; no outcome-based replacement.
